about: Five small sessions of the phase-4 golden corpus (phase4/golden in the measurement records, not in the repo; 50 sessions recorded 2026-09-27 on the unchanged v4 engine, duckcore tree cdc8ead = git 79cc25d), vendored so CI replays them on every run: each file is a Config, the inputs the duck was given and the chain head v4 produced. Chosen for coverage: hands and a head hold (g04), falls, righting, struggling, docking and the nest look (g07, g41), a legacy household with parties (g20), failed stand-ups (g45, the only session with body.stand_failed). tests/test_golden_corpus.py replays them, and all 50 when the full corpus is on this machine. Plus one prefix (prefixes): g48's first two inputs, the corpus's session with an expression caps file, with the caps file itself (caps/).

prefixes.about: The first two inputs of g48 (the corpus's one session with an expression caps file; the phase-4 review's test gap: 蛋黃 also has one): its Config names caps/expression_caps.json relative to this folder, vendored byte-identical to the corpus's (caps_sha256). Head and events are v4's own marks after input 2.
